headline: Futures point higher (+2.84%), the S&P 500 is 11.6% below its high, this is a correction, the mood is extreme fear.
summary: The index is below its 200-day average, which is when to be most careful. Fear this deep has usually been a better time to buy than to sell, but it can get worse first.

lines.t: S&P 500 futures +2.84%
Nasdaq futures +3.59%
VIX (fear gauge) 29.9, −16.7% from the last close
10-year Treasury yield 4.91%, down 0.14 points
US dollar +0.03%
Last close 6910.39: −3.70% on the day, −8.6% over five days, +0.9% this year.
It is 9.4% below its 50-day average and 6.0% below its 200-day average. Below the 200-day average is where most deep declines happen.
43% of big stocks are above their own 50-day average, down from 72% a week ago. 0 are at one-year highs and 28 at one-year lows.
In the last 10 years there were 13 finished pullbacks of 5% or more. 9 bottomed before falling this far; 4 went deeper. A typical one took about 78 days to get back to its high.
Strongest last session: Consumer Staples +0.7%, Health Care −0.1%.
Weakest: Technology −7.3%, Industrials −3.1%.
Over five days money moved toward Consumer Staples and away from Technology.
Fear and greed score: 6 of 100, extreme fear. A week ago it was 37.
Most fearful gauge: money in rising stocks (41% of the money traded went into rising stocks). Least fearful: appetite for risky bonds.
After past extreme fear days the S&P 500 was higher a month later 65% of the time, averaging +2.3%.
Bitcoin fear and greed (alternative.me): 11, extreme fear.
Wed Nov 25 8:30 AM: Core PCE Price Index m/m (expected 0.3%, last 0.3%). The inflation measure the Fed itself watches most.
Wed Nov 25 8:30 AM: Prelim GDP q/q (expected 3.5%, last 3.4%). How fast the economy is growing.

sections.title: What kind of market this is

lines.t: Correction. 10% to 20% below the high. It has been this way for 1 trading day, after a stretch of pullback. From days like this the S&P 500 was higher three months later 74% of the time, averaging +5.8%.
Painful but historically a better time to add than to sell, with big swings on the way.
